optimized_details.code_snippet:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
daily = df.groupby('Date')['Revenue'].sum().reset_index().sort_values('Date')
print('Daily Revenue Aggregation:\n', daily.head(5))
fig = px.line(daily, x='Date', y='Revenue', title='Daily Revenue Trend', markers=True)
fig.write_html('output.html', include_plotlyjs='cdn')
